newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa sees share transfer restrictions.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa sees share transfer restrictions.

text.p: German airline Deutsche Lufthansa AG said on Tuesday it expected that following draft airline share ownership laws from Bonn, all of its shares would in future carry transfer restrictions.
"That is what we expect," a Lufthansa spokesman said in response to enquiries.
He added that a flotation of the remaining 36 percent stake in the airline held by the government was likely to proceed around the fourth quarter of this year.
The spokesman said the airline welcomed the draft law enabling full privatisation and described the proposed measures aimed at ensuring a majority of German ownership in the airline as "appropriate".
Airlines must ensure they have a majority of domestic shareholders in accordance with national air sector agreements between most countries.
The spokesman said assuming that the new law was passed, Lufthansa would be holding a meeting of shareholders on June 26 at which the expected implications for its shares would have to be approved.
